question: Does consolidating private episodes into a bounded, action-conditioned semantic graph with contradiction handling beat the validated policy-only episodic retrieval (Experiment 003, condition B) when the world changes, without losing its benefit when the world does not?
depends_on: Experiment 003 accepted policy-only retrieval (docs/experiment-003-result.md). Prediction retrieval stays disabled in every arm.

mechanism.node: an exact primitive action in a context (recurrent latent plus felt drive), with a signed health/fullness/pain outcome class
mechanism.equivalence: predictive and action-conditioned, never visual: same action, same outcome class, context distance below 192
mechanism.evidence: support +2 per merged observation, capped at 1024, minus 1 per 128 idle ticks
mechanism.contradiction: an observation of the same action in a nearby context with a different outcome class halves the older node's support
mechanism.capacity: 16 nodes; the weakest by (support, last tick, id) is forgotten
mechanism.retrieval: fixed top-4 summaries, one node per distinct action first, through the same policy consensus rule as raw episodes
mechanism.checkpoint: versioned, validated, migrates a never-written graph; with the graph off, state and fingerprints are bit-identical to before (all retained traces replay exactly)

development_check_not_a_result: A synthetic reversal unit test (graph_follows_a_reversal_no_later_than_raw_episodes) showed the graph switching to the new best action after 3 rounds against 21 for raw episodes. It used no preregistered seed, runs no game, and only shows the experiment can in principle detect a difference. Whether live behaviour matches is unknown and may well not.
seed_provenance: none of these appears in any earlier preregistration, harness, test, or run directory

conditions.G: SIM_LUANTI_EPISODIC=graph (policy retrieval served by the semantic graph)

reversal.meaning: after 40 scored choices forward thrust returns fullness and backward thrust takes it away

controls: fresh reset world and newborn checkpoint per arm
same genome identity, runtime seed, map seed, starting pose, health 20 and hunger 10 within a seed and variant
arms run in the fixed order A, B, G within each seed, variant reversal then stationary
action histories may diverge between arms

validity: fixture valid for every seed and variant: A has baseline exposure valid, fullness increases > 0 and decreases > 0, and every arm records its full scored-choice count
all 48 live traces replay exactly through the runtime
prediction independence: graph_enabled cannot change any prediction (unit test enabling_the_graph_cannot_change_any_prediction), so the prediction-regression tolerance of zero holds by construction
primary_reversal_G_vs_B: post-reversal resource returns G exceed B by at least 16 in aggregate AND post-reversal resource losses B exceed G by at least 16
at least 6 of 8 pairs have more post-reversal returns for G than B, and no pair has fewer
mediation: graph contradictions applied > 0 and graph-driven action changes > 0 summed over G arms
non_inferiority_stationary_G_vs_B: aggregate resource returns G >= B - 8 and aggregate resource losses G <= B + 8
no pair has G returns below B returns by more than 4
G still beats A: aggregate returns G exceed A by at least 16
decision_rules.otherwise: graph consolidation is rejected and the validated configuration stays raw policy-only retrieval (B). Each part is reported separately; no composite score.
decision_rules.later_gates_unaffected: Spatial memory (8C) needs only the validated policy-only configuration and does not wait on this decision.

secondary_report_only: graph nodes retained (maximum 16), nodes created and evicted (churn), contradictions applied
policy flips between consecutive scored choices in the stationary variant (retrieval stability)
online one-step body and vision prediction error of each arm, diagnostic only

exclusions_and_stopping.runs: every one of the 48 arms is run exactly once; no early stopping and no additional seeds
exclusions_and_stopping.infrastructure_failure: an arm that fails before writing a result is rerun once before any result is inspected; a second failure stops the experiment as incomplete
exclusions_and_stopping.frozen_build: the driver refuses a dirty tracked tree and runs every arm and the analysis from a snapshot binary and script copied into the run directory
exclusions_and_stopping.after_outcomes: this file, the seeds, and the thresholds are not revised after any outcome is generated; the seeds are consumed whatever the result
